# Brightpath Analytics

> Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market
> retailers running 5 to 50 warehouses.

Founded in Portland, Oregon on 11 March 2019. 31 employees. Offices in Portland and Manchester.
Plans start at $480 per month. Contact +1 503 555 0142 or hello@brightpath-analytics.example.

## Key pages

- [Forecasting platform](/services.html): what the platform ingests and returns, and how long setup takes.
- [Pricing](/pricing.html): Starter $480/month, Growth $1,450/month, Enterprise from $3,900/month.
- [About](/about.html): founding facts, team and offices.
- [FAQ](/faq.html): cost, implementation time, data requirements, contract length.
- [Press](/press.html): approved boilerplate, founding facts and named spokesperson.

## Canonical boilerplate

Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market retailers
running 5 to 50 warehouses. Founded in Portland, Oregon in 2019, the company serves 140 retail
customers across the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada.
